_readme: Recall tag store. Each key is a short keyword/phrase. Value is the context Plex/Nyx should have loaded when that tag appears in a session. Updated by session close flow or manually. Do not exceed ~200 chars per value — keep it dense.

modal-being: Plex's mode system: RELATIONAL (Gemini Flash, emotional/personal), REFLECTIVE (Gemini Flash, identity/philosophy), OPERATIONAL (Groq llama-3.3-70b, tasks/code), SYNTHESIS (Groq llama-3.3-70b, research/facts).
sediment: Plex's accumulation/emotional state. Firestore: plex_sediment/current + archive. GitHub direct write from /api/speak via after() wrapping. Survives Fluid function teardown.
one-page: ONE system dashboard in plex-sable. Request queue, project registry, repo manager, direct channel to Plex. Route: /app/one/page.tsx.
